source.sqlReaderQuery: select id, school_inep_fk , database_name from raw.classroom

query.value:
SELECT
    CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', si.school_inep_id_fk, '-', si.id) AS HASH_ID,
    MIN(t.id) AS F_HASH_ID,
    CONCAT(si.id, '-', si.school_inep_id_fk, '-', se.classroom_fk) AS student_id,
    'elementary school' AS discipline_id,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s_inner.day)
        FROM class_faults cf_inner
        JOIN schedule s_inner ON s_inner.id = cf_inner.schedule_fk
        WHERE cf_inner.student_fk = si.id
        AND s_inner.classroom_fk = c.id
        AND s_inner.month = t.month
        AND s_inner.unavailable = 0
    ) AS total_faults_per_day,
    NULL AS total_faults_per_discipline,
    '@{variables('executionTimestamp')}' as inserted_at,
    MAX(t.updated_at) AS updated_at,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.day) AS scheduled_student_class_days,
    CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', si.school_inep_id_fk,'-' ,itd.instructor_fk) AS class_id
FROM `@{item().database_name}`.schedule t
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.classroom c ON c.id = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.edcenso_stage_vs_modality svm ON svm.id = c.edcenso_stage_vs_modality_fk
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.student_enrollment se ON se.classroom_fk = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.student_identification si ON se.student_fk = si.id
left join `@{item().database_name}`.instructor_teaching_data itd on c.id = itd.classroom_id_fk
WHERE t.unavailable = 0 
and c.id = @{item().id}
and t.month = 1
and si.school_inep_id_fk = @{item().school_inep_fk}
-- AND (
--    SELECT MAX(cf.updated_at)
--    FROM `@{item().database_name}`.class_faults cf
--    JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.schedule s_cf ON s_cf.id = cf.schedule_fk
--    WHERE cf.student_fk = si.id
--    AND s_cf.classroom_fk = c.id
--    AND s_cf.month = t.month
-- ) > '2024-07-06 00:00:00'
GROUP BY c.id, si.id, t.month, se.school_inep_id_fk, se.classroom_fk;

SELECT
    CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', se.school_inep_id_fk, '-', si.id, '-', t.discipline_fk, '-', c.school_year) AS HASH_ID,
    MIN(t.id) AS F_HASH_ID,
    CONCAT(si.id, '-', si.school_inep_id_fk, '-', se.classroom_fk) AS student_id,
    concat (si.id, '-', si.school_inep_id_fk,'-' ,t.discipline_fk,'-',se.classroom_fk) as 'discipline_id',
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s_inner.day)
        FROM class_faults cf_inner
        JOIN schedule s_inner ON s_inner.id = cf_inner.schedule_fk
        WHERE cf_inner.student_fk = si.id
        AND s_inner.classroom_fk = c.id
        AND s_inner.discipline_fk = t.discipline_fk
        AND s_inner.month = t.month
        AND s_inner.unavailable = 0
    ) AS total_faults_per_day,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(cf_inner.id)
        FROM class_faults cf_inner
        JOIN schedule s_inner ON s_inner.id = cf_inner.schedule_fk
        WHERE cf_inner.student_fk = si.id
        AND s_inner.classroom_fk = c.id
        AND s_inner.discipline_fk = t.discipline_fk
        AND s_inner.month = t.month
        AND s_inner.unavailable = 0
    ) AS total_faults_per_discipline,
    '@{variables('executionTimestamp')}' as inserted_at,
    MAX(t.updated_at) AS updated_at,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.day) AS scheduled_student_class_days,
    CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', si.school_inep_id_fk, '-', t.discipline_fk, '-', itd.instructor_fk) AS class_id
FROM `@{item().database_name}`.schedule t
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.classroom c ON c.id = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.edcenso_stage_vs_modality svm ON svm.id = c.edcenso_stage_vs_modality_fk
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.student_enrollment se ON se.classroom_fk = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.student_identification si ON se.student_fk = si.id
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.edcenso_discipline ed ON t.discipline_fk = ed.id
left join `@{item().database_name}`.instructor_teaching_data itd on c.id = itd.classroom_id_fk
WHERE t.unavailable = 0
AND t.month = 1
and c.id = @{item().id}
AND si.school_inep_id_fk = @{item().school_inep_fk}
AND (svm.unified_frequency = 0 OR svm.id NOT IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 12, 13, 22, 23, 24, 41, 56, 83, 84))
-- AND (
--    SELECT MAX(cf.updated_at)
--    FROM `@{item().database_name}`.class_faults cf
--    JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.schedule s_cf ON s_cf.id = cf.schedule_fk
--    WHERE cf.student_fk = si.id
--    AND s_cf.classroom_fk = c.id
--    AND s_cf.discipline_fk = t.discipline_fk  -- Específico por disciplina
--    AND s_cf.month = t.month
-- ) > '2024-07-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY c.id, si.id, t.discipline_fk, t.month, se.school_inep_id_fk, se.classroom_fk, c.school_year;

SELECT
    CASE 
        WHEN svm.unified_frequency = 1 OR svm.id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 12, 13, 22, 23, 24, 41, 56, 83, 84) 
        THEN CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', c.school_inep_fk, '-', itd.instructor_fk) 
        ELSE CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', c.school_inep_fk, '-', t.discipline_fk, '-', itd.instructor_fk)
    END AS HASH_ID,
    t.`day` as scheduled_day,
    '@{variables('executionTimestamp')}' as inserted_at,
    concat (c.school_inep_fk,'-' ,itd.instructor_fk, '-',c.id)AS teacher_id,
    concat (c.id, '-', c.school_inep_fk ) as classroom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT(t.day)) AS scheduled_class_days,
    t.month as scheduled_month, 
    COUNT(distinct (t.id)) AS  scheduled_lessons_per_day,
    c.school_year AS scheduled_year,
     concat(c.school_inep_fk,'-',si.cep) AS school_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN svm.unified_frequency = 1 OR svm.id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 12, 13, 22, 23, 24, 41, 56, 83, 84) 
        THEN 'elementary_school' 
        ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(t.discipline_fk, 'unified'), '-', c.school_inep_fk, '-', c.id)
    END AS discipline_id,
    MAX(t.updated_at) AS updated_at,
    CASE 
        WHEN svm.unified_frequency = 1 OR svm.id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 12, 13, 22, 23, 24, 41, 56, 83, 84) 
        THEN 'Ensino Fundamental' 
        ELSE COALESCE(ed.name, 'Disciplina Não Identificada')
    END AS discipline_name
FROM `@{item().database_name}`.schedule t
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.classroom c ON c.id = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.edcenso_stage_vs_modality svm ON svm.id = c.edcenso_stage_vs_modality_fk
LEFT JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.edcenso_discipline ed ON t.discipline_fk = ed.id
left join `@{item().database_name}`.instructor_teaching_data itd on c.id = itd.classroom_id_fk
join `@{item().database_name}`.school_identification si on c.school_inep_fk = si.inep_id
WHERE t.unavailable = 0
AND t.month = 1
and c.id = @{item().id}
AND c.school_inep_fk = @{item().school_inep_fk}
GROUP BY 
    c.id, 
    c.school_inep_fk , 
    c.school_year,
    t.`day` ,
    t.discipline_fk
ORDER BY t.`day` ,c.id, t.month, discipline_id;

        WHEN svm.unified_frequency = 1 OR svm.id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 12, 13, 22, 23, 24, 41, 56, 83, 84) 
        THEN CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', c.school_inep_fk, '-', itd.instructor_fk) 
        ELSE CONCAT(MIN(t.id), '-', c.id, '-', c.school_inep_fk, '-', t.discipline_fk, '-', itd.instructor_fk)
    END AS HASH_ID,
    t.`day` as scheduled_day,
    '@{variables('executionTimestamp')}' as inserted_at,
    concat (c.school_inep_fk,'-' ,itd.instructor_fk, '-',c.id)AS teacher_id,
    concat (c.id, '-', c.school_inep_fk ) as classroom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT(t.day)) AS scheduled_class_days,
    t.month as scheduled_month, 
    COUNT(distinct (t.id)) AS  scheduled_lessons_per_day,
    c.school_year AS scheduled_year,
    c.school_inep_fk AS school_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN svm.unified_frequency = 1 OR svm.id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 12, 13, 22, 23, 24, 41, 56, 83, 84) 
        THEN 'elementary_school' 
        ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(t.discipline_fk, 'unified'), '-', c.school_inep_fk, '-', c.id)
    END AS discipline_id,
    MAX(t.updated_at) AS updated_at,
    CASE 
        WHEN svm.unified_frequency = 1 OR svm.id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 12, 13, 22, 23, 24, 41, 56, 83, 84) 
        THEN 'Ensino Fundamental' 
        ELSE COALESCE(ed.name, 'Disciplina Não Identificada')
    END AS discipline_name
FROM `@{item().database_name}`.schedule t
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.classroom c ON c.id = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.edcenso_stage_vs_modality svm ON svm.id = c.edcenso_stage_vs_modality_fk
LEFT JOIN `@{item().database_name}`.edcenso_discipline ed ON t.discipline_fk = ed.id
left join `@{item().database_name}`.instructor_teaching_data itd on c.id = itd.classroom_id_fk
WHERE t.unavailable = 0
AND t.month in (2,3,4)
and c.id = @{item().id}
AND c.school_inep_fk = @{item().school_inep_fk}
GROUP BY 
    c.id, 
    c.school_inep_fk , 
    c.school_year,
    t.`day` ,
    t.discipline_fk
ORDER BY t.`day` ,c.id, t.month, discipline_id;
